connector.name: substack-ops
connector.registryDescription: Substack CLI + 26-tool MCP server. Your IDE drafts replies via propose_reply. No API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package substack-ops. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 06ketan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SUBSTACK_PUBLICATION_URL
env.description: Your Substack publication URL (e.g. https://you.substack.com/). Optional if set in ~/.cursor/mcp.json's mcpServers.substack-api.env.

env.name: SUBSTACK_USER_ID
env.description: Your Substack numeric user id. Optional if set in ~/.cursor/mcp.json.

env.name: SUBSTACK_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: Your Substack session cookie value (the s%3A... string). Required for authenticated calls. Easier path: run `substack-ops auth login --browser chrome` and the cookie is auto-grabbed.

env.name: SUBSTACK_OPS_MCP_PATH
env.description: Override path to the mcp.json file the auth layer reads. Defaults to ~/.cursor/mcp.json.

env.name: SUBSTACK_OPS_LLM_CMD
env.description: Optional: override the host CLI used by the unattended daemon path (default: auto-detect claude / cursor-agent / codex on PATH). Use {prompt} placeholder if your CLI takes the prompt as an arg.
